tasks.title: Final verification of mobile responsive implementation
tasks.description:
Verify that the calculator application is fully responsive on mobile devices by reviewing the existing implementation and test results:

1. Read the comprehensive review report at .eunomia/screenshots/developer/RESPONSIVE_REVIEW_REPORT.md to understand what was verified

2. Confirm the report shows all acceptance criteria passed:
   - Mobile rendering (375px-414px width)
   - Touch target sizes (44px minimum)
   - Text readability across screen sizes
   - Layout adaptation (mobile/tablet/desktop)
   - All 118 tests passing

3. Run the test suite to verify current state:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Confirm all tests still pass

4. Check responsive screenshots exist in .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ for:
   - Mobile viewports (iPhone SE 375x667, iPhone XR 414x896)
   - Tablet viewport (iPad 768x1024)
   - Desktop viewport (1920x1080)

5. Review the responsive CSS implementation:
   - src/components/Calculator.css (media queries at 768px, 480px, 320px)
   - src/components/Button.css (44px minimum touch targets)
   - src/components/Display.css (overflow handling)

6. Provide final confirmation that the application is fully responsive on mobile devices
acceptance_criteria: Review report confirms all responsive design criteria met
Test suite passes with 100% success rate
Screenshots show correct layout at mobile (375px-414px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1920px) viewports
CSS implementation includes proper media queries for mobile breakpoints
Touch targets meet 44px minimum accessibility requirement
Final confirmation provided that application is fully mobile responsive
